prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1003; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection and was diagnosed with concussion. Over the course of 27 visits, care consisted of symptom monitoring, graded return-to-activity guidance, vestibular and cognitive assessment, and targeted physical therapy. Mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the patient's symptoms are plausible given the forces involved. Several examination findings support the clinical diagnosis, including reproducible headache complaints and abnormal balance performance on structured testing, while other neurological screens and imaging-related checks returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck region is documented in the records available to this provider. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to full activity. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified.
